title: Peer health dashboard via admin endpoint
description:
Extend the /admin/peers endpoint with enough detail for operators to diagnose peering problems without grepping logs.

Why this issue exists:
The current /admin/peers endpoint returns a list of peer addresses. It does not show whether peers are reachable, when they last exchanged articles, how many articles have been exchanged, or whether reconciliation is succeeding. Operators diagnosing a peering problem currently have to grep structured logs.

Scope:
Extend GET /admin/peers response to include per-peer:
- address: configured address
- connected: bool (TCP connection currently open)
- last_seen: ISO8601 timestamp of last successful message exchange
- last_reconcile: ISO8601 timestamp of last gossip reconcile attempt
- reconcile_ok: bool (last reconcile completed without errors)
- articles_sent: counter (articles sent to this peer since daemon start)
- articles_received: counter (articles received from this peer since daemon start)
- groups_shared: list of group names both peers subscribe to

Add GET /admin/peers/<address>/ping — attempts a TCP connect and returns latency in ms. Used for manual liveness checks from the CLI.

Acceptance criteria:
- GET /admin/peers returns the extended fields for each configured peer
- connected=false for a peer whose TCP connection is down
- last_reconcile and reconcile_ok update after each gossip reconcile cycle
- ctl peers (from the admin CLI epic) displays the extended fields in a table
